meaning.text: The three independently evaluated language-quality dimensions plus the explicit user-confirmation posture.

properties.name: semantic_grounding
properties.meaning: Whether every proposed language item is grounded in user language.

properties.name: non_collapse
properties.meaning: Whether every candidate-term pair remains operationally distinguishable.

properties.name: orthogonality
properties.meaning: Whether every applicable classification-axis pair is independent or explicitly coupled.

properties.name: user_confirmed
properties.meaning: Whether the user explicitly confirmed the candidate language.

meaning.text: A non-authoritative gate result naming pass, review, or block and the next repair focus.

properties.name: repair_focus
properties.meaning: The single language dimension that needs the next user interaction.

properties.name: authority_effect
properties.meaning: Always none; readiness does not promote meaning or authorize effects.
